note: Prompt 08 upgrade catalogue: 16 cards in five sectors. Loaded by ProgressionSystem.cards() into UpgradeDefinition.
numbers: Every parts cost, tier and effect size here is game balance (ProgressionBalance), not a NASA figure. Mechanisms name their source id in docs/source_register.md.
tier_rule: Per sector: tier 0 unfamiliar; tier 1 = a guided task done and its explanation question answered; tier 2 = a diagnosis in a changed example (a different situation from the guided one) plus the next practical evidence; tier 3 = a transfer to new operating conditions or a controlled comparison. Tiers are shared colony progress and never go down.

tiers.words: Guided task: fixed dusty panels and explained why they gave less power
Diagnosed a power loss in a changed example and predicted the battery from the readings
Checked the fix worked and planned for a dust storm (new conditions)
Guided task: ran both oxygen makers and explained which one needs water
Diagnosed an oxygen problem in a changed example and told the tanks from the cabin air
Brought CO2 back down and planned for more crew (new conditions)
Guided task: inspected a plant symptom and explained its cause
Diagnosed a symptom in a changed example and changed exactly one input
Saw the bed respond and used what you learned on another crop (new conditions)
Guided task: inspected a salvage donor and chose the compatible part
Judged a part in a changed example and passed a bench test
Planned salvage from a new wreck (new conditions)
Guided task: took a field sample with its site, time and conditions
Read an odd result in a changed example and compared with a reference and a control
Applied a lab result to a real colony setting and checked it (controlled comparison)

energy_predict_net_power.words: Predict the battery from the readings (question at the power panel)

energy_diagnose_output_loss.words: Clean a dusty panel or repair the cleaner while the panels give less than 80 % of their clean power

energy_verify_recovery.words: See the panels back above 95 % of their clean power within a sol of that fix

ls_distinguish_inputs.words: Run the electrolyser and the CO2-oxygen unit for at least one hour each

ls_co2_removal.words: Bring cabin CO2 back below the warning level after it rose

ls_storage_vs_pressure.words: Explain oxygen tanks vs cabin pressure (question at the life-support console)

food_compare_symptom.words: Inspect a plant symptom and read the measurement that proves it

food_adjust_one_cause.words: Change exactly one input on a bed that shows a symptom

food_observe_response.words: See that bed grow faster after the change

res_identify_compatible.words: Inspect a salvage donor and choose the compatible part

res_assembly_test.words: Refurbish a component that passes its bench test

sci_record_context.words: Take a field sample with its site, time and conditions

sci_compare_controls.words: Compare the sample with the reference and a control in the lab

sci_apply_result.words: Apply a lab result to a real colony setting

cards.title: Battery reserve for life support
cards.function: Adds battery modules and a guard: room lights and greenhouse lights can no longer use the last part of the battery, so the air and water machines keep running through a long night.
cards.effect: Battery capacity +25 % (800 → 1000 kWh). The last 20 % of the battery is kept for life support: lights are switched off first when only the reserve is left.
source_labels: Game balance: battery size and reserve share (fiction 2080 battery bank).
Physics: no sunlight at night, so night power must be stored.

cards.title: Better sun tracking
cards.function: Tunes the tracker motors so they follow the sun more exactly and use less power doing it.
cards.effect: Tracker drives use half the power (0.6 → 0.3 kW) and tracking panels give 10 % more power.
source_labels: Physics: a panel facing the sun catches more light.
Game balance: the size of the gain and the motor power.

cards.title: Self-repairing panel cleaner
cards.function: Gives the panel cleaner a spare drive and a self-test, so it fixes itself instead of waiting for a repair trip.
cards.effect: If the cleaner breaks, it repairs itself after one sol and keeps wiping the panels at sunrise. The repair chore goes away.
source_labels: Game balance: one sol to self-repair.
Simplified: Mars dust on panels is real (see the dust note in the register); a self-repairing cleaner is fiction 2080 equipment.

cards.title: Reliable water recycler
cards.function: Adds a second filter stage and a pump service kit to the water recycler.
cards.effect: The recycler cleans 1 L more wastewater per hour (3 → 4 L/h) and its condition never drops below 0.8, so its water stays clean enough for the electrolyser.
source_labels: ISS analog (S08): water recovery of about 90 percent.
Game balance: the extra litre per hour and the condition floor.

cards.title: Stronger electrolyser
cards.function: Adds more cell stacks to the electrolyser that splits water into oxygen and hydrogen.
cards.effect: Up to 50 % more oxygen per hour (0.2 → 0.3 kg/h) at the same 6 kWh per kg. It still uses 1.126 L of water per kg of oxygen, so it needs more feed water when it runs flat out.
source_labels: ISS analog (S08): oxygen made by electrolysis of water.
Physics: 1.126 L of water per kg of oxygen.
Game balance: the output and the energy per kg.

cards.title: Bigger CO2-oxygen unit
cards.function: Adds a second processing core to the unit that takes oxygen from the carbon dioxide in the Mars air.
cards.effect: Up to 50 % more oxygen per hour (0.15 → 0.225 kg/h) at the same 20 kWh per kg. It still needs no water.
source_labels: Technology demonstration on Mars (S09, MOXIE): oxygen from atmospheric CO2, best 12 g per hour.
Fiction scaled from S09: a colony-size unit and its upgrade.

cards.title: Oxygen and cabin-air monitor
cards.function: Adds sensors and a forecast screen for the oxygen tanks and the cabin air.
cards.effect: Warnings come earlier and say how long is left: oxygen reserve warning at 30 kg instead of 20 kg, cabin oxygen at 20 kPa instead of 19 kPa, CO2 at 0.4 kPa instead of 0.5 kPa, and an oxygen forecast line on the screen. The air itself does not change.
source_labels: Physics: partial pressure from the ideal gas law.
Game balance: the warning levels.

cards.title: Reliable irrigation
cards.function: Adds drip lines and a level sensor to every bed.
cards.effect: Beds never dry out while water is allocated to the greenhouse.
source_labels: ISS analog (S11): plants grown in Veggie need water delivered to the roots.
Game balance: bed water levels.

cards.title: Nutrient metering
cards.function: Adds a meter and a dosing pump for plant nutrients.
cards.effect: The nutrient level of every bed is held in the good band automatically.
source_labels: ISS analog (S11).
Game balance: the nutrient band.
No source yet for fertilizer amounts (register section 10).

cards.title: Scheduled plant care
cards.function: Adds timers to the grow lights and the watering.
cards.effect: Grow lights and watering run on a schedule with no player action.
source_labels: ISS analog (S11): Veggie runs lights on a schedule.
Game balance: the schedule.

cards.title: Salvage scanner
cards.function: A hand scanner that reads size, voltage and type labels on salvage.
cards.effect: Inspecting a donor shows every compatible part at once.
source_labels: Game balance and fiction 2080 equipment.
Rule kept: nothing is made from nothing.

cards.title: Refurbishing jig
cards.function: A jig and tool set for the workbench.
cards.effect: Refurbishing takes less time and recovers one more part from a donor.
source_labels: Game balance and fiction 2080 equipment.

cards.title: Assembly records
cards.function: Keeps a tested record of every component type assembled at the bench.
cards.effect: A component type assembled before needs no bench test again.
source_labels: Game balance and fiction 2080 equipment.

cards.title: Instrument calibration
cards.function: Calibration standards for the lab instrument.
cards.effect: Lab results carry a smaller uncertainty.
source_labels: Mission and instrument provenance only (S06, MSL CheMin, PARTIAL).
Any mineral value in the lab is illustrative, not from the archive.

cards.title: Second reference sample
cards.function: A second reference sample for the lab.
cards.effect: A second reference sample becomes available for comparisons.
source_labels: Mission and instrument provenance only (S06, S07, PARTIAL).
Any mineral value in the lab is illustrative, not from the archive.

cards.title: Evidence-based settings
cards.function: Links the lab's result sheet to the greenhouse and equipment controls.
cards.effect: Lab results can be applied directly to crop and equipment settings.
source_labels: Game balance.
A lab result is a model value in this game, not a measurement of the fictional map.
